summary: Creative Global Technology Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting and Class B Meeting. Proposals approved include: (1) increasing Class B share voting rights from 20 to 100 votes per share; (2) increasing authorized share capital from US$2M to US$90M; (3) reducing par value from US$0.001 to US$0.00001 per share (credited to share premium); and (4) adopting amended articles. All proposals passed with over 95% quorum. No offer, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is disclosed; this is a routine shareholder authorization for capital structure changes. No deal terms apply. The filing is a foreign issuer's report of corporate governance amendments, not a special situation.
